title: Esau Sold His Birthright for a Bowl of Stew | Bible Story
description:
Discover the powerful story of Esau and Jacob from Genesis 25:29-34, where a hungry brother traded his birthright for a single meal of lentil stew. What does this ancient tale teach us about values, priorities, and the things we are willing to sacrifice?

This Bible story explores the heart of Esau — who 'despised his birthright' — and contrasts it with Jacob's understanding of what truly matters. A timeless reminder that some blessings are too precious to trade for temporary pleasure.

📖 Scripture Reference: Genesis 25:29-34

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and share this story with someone who needs encouragement today.
